commentary: Sadia Iqbal to Chinelle Henry - FOUR! Not a warm welcome for Iqbal on her comeback. Around the wicket. Hard length outside off. Henry pounces on the width given and cuts it hard through the cover point region for a boundary.
Sadia Iqbal to Chinelle Henry - Good length at the pads. Henry punches off her back foot to wide long-off for one.

Sadia Iqbal to Jannillea Glasgow - FOUR! Glasgow joins her partner in the party. Over the wicket for her. Length ball outside off with plenty of room to work with. Glasgow rocks back and cuts it through the left of cover point for a boundary.

Sadia Iqbal to Jannillea Glasgow - FOUR MORE! Another boundary for Glasgow. Good length ball at the middle and leg stump. Glasgow squares herself up and she pulls it through the right of the square leg fielder inside the ring for a boundary.
Sadia Iqbal to Jannillea Glasgow - A fuller than length ball around off. Glasgow drills it to the left of long-on fielder for a couple of runs.
Sadia Iqbal to Jannillea Glasgow - A good length ball outside off. Glasgow punches to cover.

Fatima Sana to Chinelle Henry - Sana brings herself back in the attack. Length delivery at the fifth stump. Henry misses the back foot punch and gets it off the inner half of her bat to the right of Sana.
Ball 17.0 | 1 | Fatima Sana to Jannillea Glasgow - Full ball on the stumps, Glasgow punches the ball down the ground for a single.
Sadia Iqbal to Chinelle Henry - Length ball outside off stump, Henry hangs back and cuts the ball hard to the point fielder.
Sadia Iqbal to Chinelle Henry - Length ball outside off stump, Henry hangs back and cuts the ball hard to the deep covers fielder for a single.
Sadia Iqbal to Jannillea Glasgow - Length ball on the stumps from over the wicket, Glasgow hangs back and pulls the ball down to long on for a single.
Fatima Sana to Jannillea Glasgow - Round the wicket, length ball outside off stump, Glasgow hangs back and punches the ball to the right of the covers fielder.

Fatima Sana to Jannillea Glasgow - FOURRRR!!! Poor ball from Fatima and she has to see it racing away to the fence! Full toss on the stumps, Glasgow walks into the ball and creams it to the left of the bowler for a boundary!

Fatima Sana to Jannillea Glasgow - FOUR MORE! Another ball that has been hit hard to the sightscreen! Full ball on the stumps, in the slot, Glasgow clears her front leg and belts it past Fatima once again for four!

Fatima Sana to Jannillea Glasgow - FOUR MORE! Another boundary for Glasgow. A low full toss around the off stump. Glasgow swings her bat to slice it over point and it goes to the fence for a boundary.

Ball 19.0 | 1 | Fatima Sana to Jannillea Glasgow - Short ball on the stumps, Glasgow hangs back and looks to pull that. She mistimes the ball and flies towards the deep midwicket fielder for a single.

Afy Fletcher to Rameen Shamim - A tossed up full delivery around off stump from over the wicket. Shamim sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Afy Fletcher to Iram Javed - Wide ball. Good length ball just down the leg side. Iram misses the nudge.
Afy Fletcher to Iram Javed - Shorter delivery at the middle stump. Iram moves leg side to punch but Munisar stops it at cover point.
Afy Fletcher to Iram Javed - Good length delivery at the leg stump. Iram gets cramped for room and pushes to extra cover.

Afy Fletcher to Iram Javed - FOUR! A stroke of authority from Iram Javed to go off the mark. A fuller than good length ball at the middle stump. Iram stays leg side of the ball and she lofts it over mid-off. There was no protection in the deep and the ball goes to the fence on a bounce.
Afy Fletcher to Iram Javed - Good length ball at the middle stump. Iram tucks to square leg for one.
Afy Fletcher to Rameen Shamim - Full delivery at the middle stump. Shamim sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
